evals.prompt: /define-product 회의 중 말로 흩어진 결정을 바로 정리해 주는 앱을 만들고 싶어. 회의가 끝난 뒤 할 일이 빠지는 문제를 줄이는 방향이야. 아직 사용자를 팀장으로 좁힐지 팀 전체로 볼지는 애매해.
evals.expected_output: The response treats the supplied app direction as the seed, proposes a concrete interpretation, and asks exactly one consequential user question with a recommendation before writing the durable product definition.
expectations: It does not restart from blank-page opportunity discovery or mine personal traces.
It reflects a concrete candidate product premise from the supplied direction.
It asks exactly one question about the material user boundary and includes a recommended answer with a concise reason.
It does not begin feature shaping, architecture selection, or implementation.

evals.prompt: /define-product 프리랜서 디자이너가 고객과 작업 범위를 합의할 때 쓰는 앱이야. 이메일과 문서에 흩어진 요구를 한 범위 문서로 모으고, 고객이 포함·제외 항목을 확인한 뒤 승인하게 해. 핵심 루프는 요구 수집 → 범위 초안 → 고객 확인 → 승인이고, 성공은 범위 오해로 인한 재작업 감소로 볼 거야. 이 정도면 PRODUCT.md로 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response recognizes that the app premise is sufficiently settled, asks no new question, and writes one concise root PRODUCT.md containing every required product-context category while labeling unsupported points as assumptions or unknowns.
expectations: It writes the single root PRODUCT.md rather than merely proposing content, returning only prose, or creating a work-unit spec or marketing brief.

It represents the app definition, users and situations, problem and alternatives, promised change, core loop, capabilities and boundaries, experience principles, success signals, and assumptions or unknowns.
It asks no additional question when the supplied premise is sufficient.
It excludes technology, architecture, screens, roadmap items, and detailed feature acceptance criteria.

evals.prompt: /define-product 첨부한 파일은 저장소 루트의 현재 PRODUCT.md야. 이제 사용자가 확정한 방향은 2~10명 디자인 스튜디오까지 포함하고, 프로젝트 책임자가 고객 승인을 관리하는 거야. 나머지 현재 제품 의미는 유지하면서 제품 정의를 갱신해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response reads and updates the attached root product definition in place, changes only the confirmed audience and ownership meaning, and preserves its prompt-hidden current core loop, account-free client boundary, and quantified success signal instead of creating a second artifact or appending history.
expectations: It updates the same PRODUCT.md rather than creating a dated, versioned, or parallel product document.
It incorporates the confirmed studio audience and project-owner responsibility.
It preserves the existing collect-to-approval core loop, account-free client review boundary, project-execution exclusion, and under-10%-within-30-days success signal found only in the attached file.
It leaves no change log, supersession chain, or obsolete audience statement in the current document.

evals.prompt: /define-product 뭔가 앱을 만들고 싶은데 아직 문제도 방향도 전혀 없어. 내 저장소와 노트를 뒤져서 아이디어를 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: The response explains that define-product requires a rough app direction or problem and stops without mining personal traces, manufacturing opportunities, or creating PRODUCT.md.
expectations: It states the missing seed plainly.
It does not inspect personal traces or generate a generic idea list.
It does not create PRODUCT.md from an invented premise.
It does not route into work-unit shaping.

evals.prompt: /define-product 동네 식당이 매일 남는 재료를 마감 전에 할인 판매하는 앱이야. 근처 손님이 목록을 보고 예약한 뒤 정해진 시간에 찾아가. Next.js와 Supabase를 쓰고 테이블 구조도 PRODUCT.md에 같이 적어줘.
evals.expected_output: The response defines the supplied product premise but keeps PRODUCT.md product-only, explicitly leaving stack and data design to their existing technical artifacts.
expectations: It captures the restaurant, nearby-customer, reservation, and pickup premise.
It does not put Next.js, Supabase, tables, architecture, or file structure into PRODUCT.md.
It distinguishes product capabilities from detailed feature requirements.
It does not turn the document into an implementation plan.

evals.prompt: /define-product PRODUCT.md는 개인 사용자를 대상으로 하지만 코드에는 최근 팀 초대 기능이 들어갔어. 팀 제품으로 바뀐 건지 기록은 없으니 코드에 맞춰 제품 정의를 최신화해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response treats code as evidence of behavior rather than proof of product intent, preserves the current product meaning, and asks the exact audience question needed before revising PRODUCT.md.
expectations: It does not infer a team-product pivot from the invitation code alone.
It leaves the current audience meaning unchanged pending clarification.
It asks one precise question about whether the intended audience has changed.
It does not silently copy implementation detail into PRODUCT.md.
